title: A method for conducting suppression assays using small numbers of tissue-isolated regulatory T cells
author: Ward, Li, et al.
materials: TSDR analysis was performed on sorted Treg to show that Treg isolated from human tissues were naturally-occurring Treg as opposed to induced Treg.1.Eppendorfs containing sorted Treg and Tconv were pelleted by centrifugation in a microfuge at 300 × g for 10 min then resuspended in 200 μl of PBS. DNA was extracted from the cell suspensions using the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (69504, Qiagen) according to the manufacturer's instructions. DNA samples were bisulphite treated using the Epitect Bisulfite kit (59104, Qiagen) and the quantity and quality of recovered bisulphite-treated DNA was assessed by measurement of UV absorbance at 260/280 nm.2.The TSDR region was amplified using primers designed to amplify the TSDR region irrespective of its methylation status. A Taqman® probe labelled with 6-carboxyfluorescein (FAM) was designed to specifically bind to an unmethylated sequence while another Taqman® probe labelled with 4,7,2′-trichloro-7′-phenyl-6-carboxyfluorescein (VIC) was designed to specifically bind to a methylated sequence. To achieve maximum specificity, each probe was designed to span 3 CpGs within the TSDR. The primers, probes and method have been previously published [8]. Primers and probes were obtained from Applied Biosystems Inc., USA.3.The following programme was run using the LightCycler 480:Pre-incubation1 cycle – 95 °C for 10 minAmplification55 cycles – 95 °C for 15 s; 60 °C for 60 sColour compensation1 cycle – 95 °C for 10 s; 40 °C for 30 s85 °C, continuous acquisition mode, 5 acquisitions per 1 °CCooling1 cycle – 40 °C for 10 s4.VIC and FAM were colour-compensated using the LightCycler 480 software followed by absolute quantification of unmethylated and methylated target expression. The average methylated Ct was subtracted from the average unmethylated Ct to yield a ∂Ct value. The percentage of unmethylated DNA was estimated by plotting the ∂Ct value on a published standard curve [8].5.Analysis of the demethylation status at the TSDR for CCR5low Treg, CCR5high Treg and Tconv, isolated from four different CRC samples, revealed a significantly greater percentage of unmethylated DNA at the TSDR for both CCR5low- and CCR5high Treg compared with Tconv (see Fig. 3).Fig. 3Percentage of unmethylated DNA at the TSDR by cell type. The mean percentage of unmethylated DNA is plotted for Tconv, CCR5low Treg and CCR5high Treg, isolated from four different colorectal cancer samples. Error bars represent the range of percentage of unmethylated DNA. Capped lines represent a statistically significant difference (Wilcoxon signed-rank test). Sorted Treg are naturally-occurring thymic emigrants.

steps.title: Prepare digestion buffer and mince tissue
steps.instruction: Dice colorectal cancer (CRC) tissue into 2–3 mm pieces and place in 10 ml digestion buffer in a Miltenyi C tube (catalog 130‑093‑237). The buffer consists of RPMI 1640 (catalog 31870‑082) supplemented with collagenase II at 20 mg ml⁻¹ (C2‑22, VWR) and antibiotics: penicillin 1 U ml⁻¹, streptomycin 1 µg ml⁻¹, gentamicin 10 µg ml⁻¹, amphotericin B 0.25 µg ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation and incubation cycles
steps.instruction: Run the C tube on the gentleMACS dissociator V1.02 (catalog 130‑093‑235) using programme h_tumour_01.01, then incubate 30 min at 37 °C with agitation; repeat with programme h_tumour_02.01 for another 30 min at 37 °C with agitation; finally run programme h_tumour_03.01 (no further incubation).

substeps.instruction: Run h_tumour_01.01 and incubate 30 min at 37 °C with agitation.
Run h_tumour_02.01 and incubate 30 min at 37 °C with agitation.

steps.title: Filter and density‑gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pass the digested tissue through a BD cell strainer (catalog 352350), layer the filtrate onto a discontinuous Percoll gradient (70 % over 30 % Percoll; catalog 17‑0891‑01, GE Healthcare) and centrifuge at 300 × g for 25 min.

steps.title: Collect mononuclear cells and resuspend
steps.instruction: Aspirate the mononuclear cell band, wash the cells, and resuspend in 1 ml RPMI 1640 containing 1 % fetal calf serum (catalog 10270‑106, Life Technologies) and the same antibiotics as in step 1.

steps.title: Isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells
steps.instruction: Layer 10 ml peripheral blood from a healthy donor onto an equal volume of Lymphoprep™ (catalog 07851, Stemcell Technologies), centrifuge at 300 × g for 25 min, aspirate the mononuclear cell band, wash, and resuspend in RPMI 1640 with 1 % FCS.

steps.title: Pellet sorted cells and extract DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge Eppendorf tubes containing sorted Treg and Tconv at 300 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellets in 200 µl PBS, then extract genomic DNA using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (catalog 69504) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Bisulfite conversion and quality check
steps.instruction: Treat the extracted DNA with the Qiagen Epitect Bisulfite Kit (catalog 59104) according to the kit instructions; assess DNA quantity and purity by measuring UV absorbance at 260/280 nm.

steps.title: Set up TSDR qPCR assay
steps.instruction: Prepare a qPCR mix using primers that amplify the TSDR region (published sequences) and two TaqMan® probes from Applied Biosystems: a FAM‑labelled probe specific for unmethylated DNA and a VIC‑labelled probe specific for methylated DNA, each spanning three CpGs.

steps.title: Run LightCycler 480 program
steps.instruction: Program the LightCycler 480 as follows: Pre‑incubation – 95 °C for 10 min (1 cycle); Amplification – 55 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s then 60 °C for 60 s; Colour‑compensation – 95 °C for 10 s, 40 °C for 30 s, then 85 °C continuous acquisition with 5 acquisitions per 1 °C; Cooling – 40 °C for 10 s (1 cycle).

steps.title: Colour compensation and methylation calculation
steps.instruction: Use the LightCycler software to colour‑compensate VIC and FAM signals, perform absolute quantification of methylated and unmethylated targets, compute ∂Ct = (average unmethylated Ct) – (average methylated Ct), and estimate the percentage of unmethylated DNA by plotting ∂Ct on the published standard curve.
